verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is Adyen's official OpenAPI definitions on GitHub. Users can upload these to Swagger Editor or SwaggerHub to get an interactive, runnable reference, but that relies on third-party tooling rather than a first-party explorer. A probe of standard OpenAPI paths on docs.adyen.com returned 404, and nothing shows a hosted interactive reference or runnable examples for the Agentic Commerce APIs. Missing for 10: a first-party interactive API reference, runnable or try-it examples in the docs, coverage of the Agentic Cart/Feed/ACP/UCP endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
